name: Above 9?
description: Is the next face down card above 9?

name: Below 5?
description: Is the next face down card below 5?

name: Between 5 and 9?
conditions: Available from run start | Excluded from random pool
description: Is the value of the next face down card a 5, 6, 7, 8 or 9?

name: Is it an Ace?
conditions: Available from run start | Excluded from random pool
description: Reveals whether at least one Ace appears in the next three face down cards.

name: Is it a King?
conditions: Available from run start | Excluded from random pool
description: Reveals whether the next face down card is a King.

name: Ace ahead?
description: Reveals whether at least one Ace appears in the next three face down cards.

name: King ahead?
description: Reveals whether at least one King appears in the next three face down cards.

name: Number Remaining?
description: Reveals how many copies of the next face down card's rank are still left in the deck, including that next card.

name: Total of Next Two
description: Reveals the total of the next two face down cards.

name: Total of Next Three
description: Reveals the total of the next three face down cards.

name: Total Above 12?
conditions: Available from run start | Excluded from random pool
description: Reveals whether the next two face down cards total more than 12.

name: Total Above 20?
description: Reveals whether the next two face down cards total more than 20.

name: Total Under 10?
conditions: Available from run start | Excluded from random pool
description: Reveals whether the next two face down cards total less than 10.

name: Total Under 15?
conditions: Meta progression >= 5 | Excluded from random pool
description: Reveals whether the next two face down cards total less than 15.

name: Prime Ahead?
conditions: Meta progression >= 15 | Excluded from random pool
description: Reveals whether the next face down card is prime-valued: 2, 3, 5, 7, J = 11, or K = 13.

name: Product of Next Two
description: Reveals the product of the next two face down cards.

name: Top Half / Bottom Half
description: Is the next card below 7 or is it 7 and above?

name: Face Card Ahead?
description: Reveals whether at least one face card (J, Q, or K) appears in the next three face down cards.

name: What is it Not?
description: Reveals two remaining cards that the next face-down card is not.

name: One of Next 2 Higher?
description: Reveals if at least one of the next two cards is higher than the current card.

name: One of Next 2 Lower?
description: Reveals if at least one of the next two cards is lower than the current card.

name: Higher of Next Two
description: Reveals the highest value of the next two face down cards.

name: Lower of Next Two
description: Reveals the lowest value of the next two face down cards.

name: Next Card Parity
description: Reveals if the next card is odd, even or a picture card.

name: Chance Higher
conditions: Meta progression >= 50 | Excluded from random pool
description: Calculates the probability that one of the remaining cards is higher than the current card.

name: Chance Lower
conditions: Meta progression >= 50 | Excluded from random pool
description: Calculates the probability that one of the remaining cards is lower than the current card.

name: Nudge +1
conditions: Available from run start | Excluded when power 'nudge_engine' is active
description: Increases the value of the current face card by one for the next guess.

name: Nudge -1
conditions: Available from run start | Excluded when power 'nudge_engine' is active
description: Decreases the value of the current face card by one for the next guess.

name: Nudge +2
conditions: Meta progression >= 30 | Excluded when power 'nudge_engine' is active
description: Increases the value of the current face card by two, stopping at King.

name: Nudge -2
conditions: Meta progression >= 30 | Excluded when power 'nudge_engine' is active
description: Decreases the value of the current face card by two, stopping at Ace.

name: Next Card Nudge Up
description: Temporarily nudges the next face-down card up by 3 for the next guess, stopping at King.

name: Next Card Nudge Down
description: Temporarily nudges the next face-down card down by 3 for the next guess, stopping at Ace.

name: Need The Nudge
description: Swap your stored Nudge +1 and Nudge -1 charge totals.

name: Nudge, Nudge
description: For this turn only, each Nudge moves the card twice as far while still costing one charge.

name: Halve It
conditions: Meta progression >= 45 | Can only be used on an even card.
description: Can only be used on an even card. Treat the current card as half its value for the next guess.

name: Double Trouble
description: Treat the current card as double its value for the next guess, up to King.

name: Odd One Out
description: For the next card only: if it is odd, you lose. Aces count as odd even under Aces Wild. Otherwise you survive.

name: Lucky 7
conditions: Meta progression >= 20 | Can only be used on a 7.
description: Play on a 7. Your next guess is safe even if it is wrong.

name: Five Alive
conditions: Available from run start | Can only be used on a 5.
description: Can only be used on a 5. Locks the 5 against nudges, and if your next guess is wrong, the run still continues.
Use only on an un-nudged 6 or 7, and it must be the first and only cheat played on that card. Nudges then lock. Guess correctly to pick 3 cheats in a row. Guess wrong and you lose.

name: Higher, Higher, Higher
description: Choose a new Power if your next three successful guesses are Higher.

name: Psycho
description: For the next three guesses, you cannot use Cheats or Nudges. Survive all three to choose a new Power.

name: Back To Square One
description: Treat the current face-up card as an Ace for the next guess.

name: Flip That Frown
conditions: Available from run start | Can only be used on a 6 or 9.
description: Can only be used on a 6 or 9. Treat a 6 as a 9, or a 9 as a 6, for the next guess.

name: King For A Day
description: Treat the current face-up card as a King for the next guess.

name: Reroll
description: Immediately choose another Cheat using this run's normal offer size.

name: 9 to 5
conditions: Meta progression >= 40 | Can only be used on a 9.
description: Can only be used on a 9. Treat the current card as a 5 for the next guess.

name: A Stitch In Time Saves...
conditions: Meta progression >= 30 | Can only be used on a 9.
description: Can only be used on a 9. If your next guess is wrong, the run continues.

name: Catch-22
conditions: Meta progression >= 50 | Can only be used on a 2.
description: Can only be used on a 2. If the next card is also a 2, choose a new Power.

name: Sixth Sense
conditions: Meta progression >= 20 | Can only be used on a 6.
description: Can only be used on a 6. Reveals whether the next card is higher, lower, or neither.

name: Twin Peek
description: Checks the next five cards and reveals whether any of them match the face-up card's current value.

name: Run Stopper
description: Checks the next five cards and reveals whether at least one Ace or King appears.

name: Bang Average
conditions: Meta progression >= 20 | Excluded from random pool
description: Reveals the exact average value of the next three face down cards.

name: God Save The King
description: Play on any face card. If the next card is a King, the run survives even if your guess is wrong.

name: Jack Of All Trades
conditions: Available from run start | Can only be used on a Jack.
description: Can only be used on a Jack. Swap the current Jack with the next face-down card and reveal that new current card.

name: Fortune Teller
description: Reveals the values of the next three face-down cards in a random order.

name: Lucky Dip
description: Reveals one random true fact about the next face-down card.

name: Split the Difference
description: Reveals the value difference between the current card and the next face-down card.

name: False Shuffle
description: Rearranges the next three face-down cards into ascending value order.

name: The River
description: Reveals the values of the next five face-down cards in a random order.

name: Equals 11
description: Arm this card. If it and the next revealed card total 11, choose 3 extra cheats.

name: WL
description: Win your next guess, then lose the one after. If you do, the run survives and you choose 3 extra cheats.

name: You Can Cheat A Cheater
description: After your next three correct guesses, choose two extra Cheats in addition to any normal rewards.

name: Suits You, Sir
description: If the next card is the same suit as the current card, gain 5 Nudge +1 and 5 Nudge -1 charges.

name: All In
description: Stake all current Nudges. Get the next three guesses correct to win double the staked Nudges back.

name: Lucky 13
description: Arm this card. If the next revealed card is a King, gain 5 Nudge +1 and 5 Nudge -1 charges.

name: Cursed Shield
description: Lose all currently stored nudges now. Your next wrong guess is survived.

name: One Life Left
description: Adds one stored life. Each life survives one wrong guess, and multiple lives can be stacked.

name: Killer Queen
description: Adds one stored save. It continues the run when you guess Lower on a Queen and reveal a King.

name: The Higher The Better
description: Locks this card's value. You must choose Higher on your next guess and gain Nudge +1 charges equal to the card-value difference.

name: The Lower The Better
description: Locks this card's value. You must choose Lower on your next guess and gain Nudge -1 charges equal to the card-value difference.

name: Suited and Booted
description: Survive your next guess regardless of outcome unless the revealed next card matches the current card's suit.

name: Always Bet On The Black
description: For the next card only: if it is a Club or a Spade, the run survives even on a wrong guess.

name: Red? Dead? Redemption
description: For the next guess, a losing guess is saved if the revealed card is a Heart or Diamond.

name: Margin Of Error
description: If your next guess is wrong by 3 or less, the run continues.

name: Corporate Icebreaker
description: Hear two true value-and-suit facts and one lie about the next three cards.

name: Legends Ahead
description: Your next Cheat pick offers Legendary Cheats only.

name: Royal Flush
description: Reveals whether the next face-down card is a royal card: 10, J, Q, K, or A.

name: The Number Of The Beast
description: Pulls all remaining face-down 6s to the top of the face-down deck, preserving every other face-down card's order.

name: Jackpot
description: Pulls all remaining face-down 7s to the top of the face-down deck, preserving every other face-down card's order.

name: Emergency Cord
description: Gain 10 Nudge +1 and 10 Nudge -1, then shuffle two random Yellow Jokers into the face-down deck.

name: Two's Company
description: Mark the next face-down 2 in the deck with a temporary 2 on its back.

name: Refund
description: After your next guess, unnecessary current-card nudges used this turn are returned.

name: Tear Corner
description: Tear off the top left corner of the current face card so it can be recognised in future runs.

name: Banish It
description: Send the current face-up card to the back of the deck and turn over the next card.

name: Swap
description: Swap the current face-up card with the next face-down card.

name: +5 Energy
description: Energy decks only. Gain 5 Energy instantly.
